items.q: Is posting a job free?
items.a: Yes — posting a job is always free. You only pay once you accept a bid, and you pay your pro directly once the job is done — Servigic never collects or holds your payment.

items.q: How does Servigic protect me if I'm not paying upfront?
items.a: Instead of holding your money, Servigic protects you with verified pros (%%idDoc%% + selfie, police-checked at higher levels), two-way ratings after every job, a masked in-app chat that only reveals your pro's contact once they're on the way, and a dispute/mediation team if something goes wrong.

items.q: What if the pro finds extra work on-site?
items.a: They submit a change order with a photo and price — you approve it before any extra work happens, and the extra amount is simply added to what you pay your pro directly.

items.q: What if I'm not satisfied?
items.a: If you are not satisfied, open a dispute after the job is done. Our team reviews photos from both sides and helps mediate a fair resolution with your pro.

items.q: Why can't I see the pro's phone number right away?
items.a: Contact details stay masked in an in-app chat until your pro marks that they're on the way — this closes the window where off-platform deals get made, protecting both of you. Emergency jobs unlock contact immediately.

items.q: How fast do bids arrive?
items.a: For emergency jobs, most customers see their first bid in under 10 minutes since every matching nearby pro is alerted instantly.

items.q: How do pros get paid?
items.a: Directly from you — %%payList%%, however you both agree. Servigic never touches that payment; pros settle their 12% commission separately through their in-app commission wallet.

items.q: Which cities?
items.a: We are starting in %%citiesSoon%%, then expanding to more countries.

items.q: Why should I book through Servigic instead of just calling the pro directly?
items.a: Booking through Servigic gets you verified and rated pros, two-way reviews, dispute support if something goes wrong, and price competition from real bids — none of which exist if you go around the platform. Repeat bookings are also just one tap with "Book again."

items.q: What happens if I or my pro cancels a booking?
items.a: Cancelling after a booking is confirmed is tracked — occasional cancellations are fine, but a high cancellation rate can pause your ability to post jobs (or a pro's job alerts) for a while. If a pro asks you to cancel so you can work with them directly, tell us — select that reason and we'll review your pro instead of counting it against you.

steps.title: 01 — Post your job
steps.desc: Pick a category, describe the problem, add up to 6 photos, and set your urgency — Emergency, Today, or Scheduled. Your exact address is captured but stays hidden until you choose a pro.

steps.title: 02 — Pros race to bid
steps.desc: Every verified provider nearby who does that trade gets an instant alert — push notification, WhatsApp, and an in-app dispatch feed. They submit price, ETA, and a message. You compare side by side, sorted by price, rating, or ETA, and can decline with a reason or send one counter-offer per bid.

steps.title: 03 — Choose, chat, track live
steps.desc: Accept a bid and in-app chat opens. Contact details and your exact address unlock once your pro is on the way. Watch status update in real time: On the way → Arrived → Working → Done, with a live map while they're en route.

steps.title: 04 — Pay directly
steps.desc: When the work is done, pay your pro directly — %%payList%%. Servigic never collects or holds your payment. Extra work needs your approval as a change order before it happens.

steps.title: 05 — Confirm & rate
steps.desc: Confirm the job is done (or it auto-confirms 24 hours after Done if there's no dispute). Both sides rate each other, and you can open a dispute if something is wrong.

trustPage.title: Built on verification, masking, and mediation.

sections.title: Pay directly, stay in control
sections.desc: You never pay Servigic upfront. You pay your pro directly after the work is done.

sections.title: Contact masking
sections.desc: Phone numbers and exact addresses stay hidden on both sides until the pro is on the way. Providers appear as an anonymous serial number ("Pro #42") and customers by first name and area only, until then. Emergency jobs unlock contact details as soon as the booking is confirmed.

sections.title: Provider verification ladder
sections.desc: Level 1: %%idDoc%% + selfie, admin-approved — can bid. Level 2 "Verified Pro": %%policeDoc%%, priority dispatch. Level 3 "Gold Ustad": 10 completed jobs at 4.5★ or higher, lowest commission.

sections.title: Change orders
sections.desc: If a provider finds extra work on-site, they submit a change order with a photo and price — you approve before any extra work happens.

sections.title: Disputes
sections.desc: If something's wrong, open a dispute before confirming — you and the provider submit photos, and our team mediates a fair resolution.

sections.title: Platform-only rule
sections.desc: Providers agree that jobs found through Servigic close on Servigic. Taking a customer off-platform after a lead is grounds for delisting — this keeps ratings, verification and dispute support meaningful for everyone.

terms.title: 1. The service
terms.desc: Servigic operates a marketplace connecting customers who need home services with independent service providers ("pros"). Servigic is not a party to the service agreement between customer and pro.

terms.title: 2. Payments
terms.desc: Customers pay the pro directly for completed work. Servigic does not collect or hold customer payments; pros pay Servigic's commission separately. Disputes follow the process described in Trust & Safety.

terms.title: 3. Provider obligations
terms.desc: Pros must be truthful in their profile, licensed/qualified for the trades they bid on where required by law, and agree not to circumvent the platform for jobs originated on Servigic.

terms.title: 4. Limitation of liability
terms.desc: Servigic is not liable for the quality of work performed by independent providers beyond the support and dispute process.

privacyWaitlist.title: Early-list signups
privacyWaitlist.desc: When you join the early list we collect your name, WhatsApp number, email (optional), city and area, and for pros also your trade, years of experience and Gmail address. We use this only to send you launch updates and early access. To opt out, reply STOP to any WhatsApp message or use the link in our emails. We detect your country from your connection to show you the right page; we do not store your IP address.

privacyLeads.title: Pro lead data (inviting service providers)
privacyLeads.desc: To invite skilled tradespeople to join Servigic we keep a business contact record: name, phone number, trade, area, shop name and where we found the contact (for example a public listing, a market visit, a referral or the early list). We use it only to invite you to register as a Pro. We contact people one to one, never in bulk. Reply STOP or tell us and we stop at once and leave you out of every list; you can also ask us to delete your record completely.

privacy.title: Data we collect

privacy.title: Location data
privacy.desc: Provider location is only shared with the matched customer, only while status is ON_MY_WAY, and pings are retained for 7 days.
